newsitem.title: CANADA: Exall arranges C$5 million gold loan.
newsitem.headline: Exall arranges C$5 million gold loan.

text.p: Exall Resources Ltd said on Tuesday that it arranged a C$5 million gold loan and hedging facility with Standard Bank London Ltd, a unit of Standard Bank Group of South Africa.

The money will be used to finance working capital to start up the Glimmer gold project near Matheson, Ontario, Exall said. It said that under the agreement, funds can be drawn as required over an eight-month period with repayment of the balance over a 2-1/2 year term. It said it expected to close the financing this month. Production at Glimmer is expected to start in December 1996.
